decisions.reason: The dashboard prize-pool accuracy requirement does not change the required FAQ content.
The source reports an inaccurate dashboard prize-pool display but does not change the Small Block prize amount, funding, winner count, or draw condition.
The dashboard observation does not revise any About-page copy or presentation requirement.
The source does not discuss or change reward allocation for mints with no or invalid referral code.
Correcting the displayed prize-pool value does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, or Chainlink VRF selection.
The empty dashboard display does not establish a change to the $15 mint revenue-allocation rules.
The source does not alter ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or post-draw reset behavior.
The dashboard prize-pool display issue does not change secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or royalty enforcement.

The separate report that NFTs are absent from the dashboard does not change the required NFT metadata attributes, and the prize-pool display modification concerns dashboard statistics rather than metadata.
Displaying the current prize-pool value accurately does not change automatic winner payout or its wallet destination.
The source contains no decision affecting the landing-page book-cover size, visibility, placement, or overlap rules.
Adding accurate dashboard prize-pool statistics does not revise the landing-page hero content or layout.
